dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey! Perfect timing. There's something I need to talk to you about. Something important. Has to be face to face.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: So this, uh, Adventurers' Guild — what kind of things do they do? And which tasks do you normally take?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You want to join the Adventurers' Guild?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: You gotta be there, what, every other day? They seem to work you pretty hard, so...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I'mma put my boys on the case! Many hands make light work and all that, y'know...

choices.text: Oh right... You want to help me.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Wait, what do you mean, "oh right"!? C'mon, that's hurtful, where's the enthusiasm?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Next time, I don't wanna hear "oh right, Itto wants to help." I wanna hear "darn right, Itto wants to help"! Got it?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: I see you as a member of the Arataki Gang! You do know that, don't you?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Every single member of my gang is like family to me. And, you know... same goes for you.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: That makes this a family matter, you get it? Which means, leave it to Itto!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Don't you worry now, I've got your back wherever you go. Whether you're cruising the city or wandering the wilds, my boys will be there!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ah, except... only in Inazuma. How am I supposed to protect you if you leave?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hah! Guess it's time for the Arataki Gang to start expanding into other nations!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't worry about me, I can look after myself!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Haha, that's the spirit! That's what makes you part of my crew.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Guess that settles it then. When I'm not around, promise me you'll carry on being a champ and living life to the max.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: And when I say being a champ — that means kicking some serious butt, alright? I don't care if you're playing card games or you're brawling — no losing! Not to anyone!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ahem... I was hoping for more of a "sorry, I didn't ask you to help, Itto" than a "thank you"!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: I know you've asked other people for help in the past, so why not me, huh? What's that about?
